test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: The given sentence has some words with incorrect spellings. Select the most appropriate option that corrects the spellings.**

Being a milionaire, he is leading a luxurius life.

options.text: Being a millioneire, he is leading a luxrious life.
Being a millionaire, he is leading a luxurious life.
Being a millionaire, he is leeding a luxurous life.
Being a millinaire, he is leading a luxurious life.

solution:
The correct answer is **"Being a millionaire, he is leading a luxurious life."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word is **'millionaire'**, not **'milionaire'** or **'millinaire.'**
 
• The word 'millionaire' is a person who has a million pounds, dollars, etc.; a very rich person. (लखपति, करोड़पति; बहुत धनी व्‍यक्ति)
 
 
• **Example:** *You want me to buy you a new car - do you think I'm a **millionaire**__ or something?*
 
 
 
• The correct spelling of the word is** 'luxurious'**, not **'luxurius' **or **'luxurous.'**
 
• The word** "luxurious" **means very comfortable; full of expensive and beautiful things. (बहुत आरामदेह; मँहगी और सुंदर विलास की वस्‍तुओं से भरा हुआ, विलासितापूर्ण)
 __
 
• **Example:** *This is a **luxurious**__ hotel.*
 
 
 
• The sentence is grammatically correct with the corrected spellings.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
